text: The maintainer's acts — resolving an UNKNOWN by a comment, approving and merging a PR, activating a waiver, editing policy paths (`.github/workflows/**`, `.warrant/local/**`), pushing a freeze tag of `design-next`, restarting the Claude Code session — are never performed by the agent: it sends in the chat «❗ Выполнить — <what>:» and one command in a bash block, without `&&` (where the rule `process` says to ask in the PR — in the PR too); it checks the result itself (`gh pr view`, `git diff`).
